verdict.rationale: Tavily is a SaaS API, so data portability is a fair question to ask of it, but the evidence documents no account-data export or offboarding capability. The usage and per-request log endpoints (tavily-docs-30, tavily-docs-31) and research-result retrieval are adjacent API features, not an 'export all my data' function.
